meta.title: Better MCP
meta.description: Per-server lazy mounting, in-app OAuth sign-in for MCP servers, and one HTTP MCP endpoint that exposes this harness's own plugin tools. Adds a sidebar MCP panel beside the Restart button: connection state per server, a lazy switch, Sign in / Sign out, and add, edit, or remove server definitions. Aggregate endpoints use a bearer token stored in the credentials store; tools that need an agent session report an error when called from an external MCP client.
